items.title: Penguins Holding a 2027 Sign
items.alt: Two different penguins in striped and spotted party hats holding a cream sign with large red 2027 numerals.
items.description: The tall penguin leans from one side while the rounder companion grips the opposite edge of the gold-trimmed sign.

items.title: Teddy Bear with Happy 2027
items.alt: Brown teddy bear in a teal star-patterned vest and party hat beside gold Happy and multicolored 2027 lettering.
items.description: One paw holds a gold star wand tied with a small teal bow, while the lifted leg suggests a happy greeting.

items.title: Dinosaur Welcoming 2027
items.alt: Friendly green triceratops in a blue paper crown leaning over orange Welcome and blue 2027 lettering.
items.description: The broad spotted frill and three cream horns frame the smiling dinosaur face above the raised lettering.

items.title: Unicorn Jumping Above 2027
items.alt: Lavender unicorn with a pink mane and gold hooves jumping through a rainbow above sparkling 2027 numerals.
items.description: The rounded pink, blue, purple and gold digits sit beneath the small leaping figure and star-trimmed rainbow.

items.title: Robot Holding a Hello 2027 Sign
items.alt: Rounded silver robot with a red bow tie holding a cream placard reading Hello 2027 in blue and red.
items.description: Unequal glowing blue square eyes and two wide wheels give the little robot a friendly mechanical silhouette.

items.title: Fox with Happy New Year 2027 Ribbon
items.alt: Seated orange fox wearing blue snowflake mittens and scarf, holding a gold Happy New Year 2027 ribbon.
items.description: The full white-tipped tail curls beside the fox's feet beneath the short arched greeting.
